functions.name: data_extraction_function
functions.description: Read the IDAT files and sample sheet of a node into a long table of Beta and M values per probe and sample, with the cohort of each sample

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column in the sample sheet that holds the cohort of each sample (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Cohort').

arguments.name: sample_sheet_name
arguments.description: File name of the sample sheet in the IDAT folder. By default samplesheet.csv or sample_sheet.csv is used.

arguments.name: sample_columns
arguments.description: Other sample sheet columns to add to every row, e.g. Age. Column names become snake_case (Age -> age).

arguments.name: pvalue_threshold
arguments.description: pOOBAH detection p-value above which a probe is masked.

arguments.name: min_beads
arguments.description: Probes measured with fewer beads are masked.
